title: Apps
description: See registered local apps, project roots, and declared App Access in one place.
inventoryDescription: Registered local development projects appear here with their exact project roots and raw App Access declarations.

sidebar.subtitle: Local development apps
sidebar.developerHint: Connect and manage local projects in Developer Mode.
sidebar.emptyHint: Open Developer Mode to connect a local project.
sidebar.noResultsDescription: Try another name or App ID.

listDescription: Filter registered apps by whether they declare App Access domains.

developerCard.title: Connect or manage a local app
developerCard.description: Connect a new local project or manage existing registrations in Developer Mode.

emptyConnectedDescription: Once you register a local development project, it will appear here with its project root and App Access declaration.
empty: Install an account app or connect a local app.

sourceManager.title: App sources
sourceManager.requirementsSummary: Select a folder containing nimi.app.yaml or nimi.app.json.
sourceManager.requirementsDetail: Nimi validates the manifest and connects the app only after the selected folder passes Runtime checks.

requirement.aiDetail: Uses an app AIConfig initialized from your recommended or default AI profile.
requirement.platformFeaturesDetail: Uses Nimi platform features declared by the app. Protected access is evaluated separately when used.
requirement.dataDetail: Stores durable app data under a managed nimi_data app root.
requirement.runtimeDetail: Requires a verified runtime package release.

aiProfile.modalHint: Choose a profile and preview the app-scope AIConfig before applying it.

aiConfig.title: AI models
aiConfig.description: Choose the Local or Cloud implementation Nimi uses when this app calls an AI capability.
aiConfig.loadFailed: This app's AI configuration could not be loaded from Runtime.
aiConfig.saveFailed: Runtime could not save this app's AI configuration.

detail.localSummary: A local development app registered with this Nimi Desktop.
detail.aboutDescription: Registration and source information currently available for this local development app.
detail.currentScopeDescription: This app comes from a project connected on this device. Its name and App Access declarations are provided by that project.
detail.accessDescription: The domains this project declares so Nimi can route supported platform capabilities.
detail.accessDeclarationNote: App Access is a project declaration, not a user permission, approval, or consent setting.
detail.noAccessDescription: This project registered without declaring any App Access domains.
detail.developerInfoDescription: Exact local source and generation details for troubleshooting this registration.
detail.readmeEmptyDescription: Add a README.md to the project root and it will appear here.
detail.runDiagnosticsDescription: Latest supervised run detail reported by the Desktop host.
detail.selectDescription: Choose a registered app from the list to inspect its details.

realmData.label: Realm data
realmData.description: Declares use of Nimi-managed realm data operations. Access is evaluated when the app uses the domain.

runtimeConsume.label: AI runtime
runtimeConsume.description: Declares use of supported AI capabilities through Nimi Runtime. Model routing can be configured on the AI models tab.

agentLocal.label: Local agents
agentLocal.description: Declares interaction with local agent capabilities exposed by Nimi.

agentConfigure.label: Agent configuration
agentConfigure.description: Declares use of supported agent configuration capabilities exposed by Nimi.

unknown.label: Unrecognized declaration
unknown.description: Nimi retains this raw value for developer diagnostics without assigning it additional meaning.

removeDevelopment.title: Remove local project
removeDevelopment.message: Remove {{app}} from Apps? This stops its current run and removes the local development registration without deleting project files.

deleteAppData.title: Delete app data
deleteAppData.message: Permanently delete the durable app data for {{app}}? This removes the release and the app's stored data. This cannot be undone.
